title: Add Invite Friends CTA to landing page hero — growth/acquisition
description: Add a viral 'Invite friends, earn credits' CTA to the landing page Hero component. Currently the landing page has no referral loop above the fold. Add a secondary button below the primary CTA that says 'Invite friends — earn 10 credits each' linking to /referrals. Track landing_referral_cta_clicked in PostHog. Only show for authenticated users (unauth users see 'Join to earn credits' instead). Style as a subtle link-button with a gift icon. Acceptance: CTA renders in Hero, links work, analytics fire, and tests cover rendering + click tracking.
notes: Added referral CTA link below hero primary CTAs for authenticated users. Uses Gift icon, links to /referrals, tracks landing_referral_cta_clicked in PostHog. All 783 tests pass. Commit: abccd0a

title: Add 'New listings in your county' email digest trigger — retention/engagement
description: Create a new cron job that sends a 'New listings in your county' email to users who haven't visited in 3+ days but have listings in their county. Query profiles with last_login_at > 3 days ago, county_id set, and is_published = true. Find listings created in the last 7 days in their county. Send a personalized email via Resend with up to 3 new listings. Track new_listing_digest_sent in PostHog. Add unsubscribe link. Acceptance: cron job runs, emails send, analytics fire, and tests cover the query + email rendering.
notes: Created new listing digest cron for 3+ day inactive members. Includes: migration (new_listing_digest_sends table + RPC), data layer, email template, API route, and tests. All 797 tests pass. Commit: 373ead9

title: Add public shareable listing page with OG image — growth/acquisition
description: Create a public, SEO-optimized listing detail page at /listing/[id] that works without authentication. Currently listing detail pages likely require auth. A public page lets members share listings on social media, driving organic traffic. Include OpenGraph meta tags with listing title, description, and image. Add a 'Share this listing' button to the authenticated listing view that copies a public link. Track listing_shared event in PostHog. Acceptance: public page renders listing data without auth, OG tags work, share button copies link, analytics fire, tests cover public access + OG metadata.
notes: Created public listing page at /listings/[id] outside (app) group so it renders without auth. Includes OG image route, full listing detail UI, login/signup CTAs for unauth visitors, share actions, JSON-LD schema, and 7 unit tests. All 808 tests pass. Commit: 988168d

title: Add 'You have new messages' in-app notification + badge — retention/engagement
description: Add an unread message count badge to the AppNav and a corresponding in-app notification. Query the messages table for unread messages where recipient_id = current user. Show a red badge on the nav Messages link. When clicked, mark messages as read. Track message_notification_badge_seen and message_thread_opened_from_badge in PostHog. This drives re-engagement by surfacing new activity. Acceptance: badge shows correct count, clicking clears badge, marks messages read, analytics fire, tests cover count accuracy + read state.

title: Add Stripe Checkout for one-time Premium lifetime purchase — revenue/monetization
description: Add a one-time 'Lifetime Premium' purchase option alongside the subscription. Create a new Stripe product/price for a one-time payment (e.g., $199 lifetime). Add a toggle on the pricing page between Monthly and Lifetime. Update the checkout session API to support both subscription and payment_intent modes. On successful payment, set subscription_tier='lifetime' and subscription_status='active' on the profile. Add a 'Lifetime' badge to profiles. Acceptance: pricing page shows both options, checkout works for lifetime, profile updates correctly, badge renders, tests cover checkout flow + profile update.
